filingText: AlphaGen Therapeutics, Inc. files this registration statement on Form S-8. The registrant is registering 12,000,000 shares of common stock under the AlphaGen Therapeutics, Inc. 2026 Inducement Plan. Proposed Maximum Aggregate Offering Price: $18,000,000. Amount of Registration Fee: $2,214. The plan may be used for equity awards to newly hired employees and consultants.
